query:
UPDATE workspace_settings
                SET git_credentials = (
                    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(elem), '[]'::jsonb)
                    FROM jsonb_array_elements(git_credentials) AS elem
                    WHERE elem->>'repo_identity' IS DISTINCT FROM $2
                ) || jsonb_build_array($3::jsonb)
                WHERE workspace_id = $1
